name: Safinamide
mechanism: Selective reversible MAO-B inhibition with additional non-dopaminergic effects on glutamate release
dosing: 50 mg once daily, may increase to 100 mg once daily based on response
contraindications: Severe hepatic impairment, concurrent use with contraindicated serotonergic agents
interactions: Serotonergic drugs (risk of serotonin syndrome), other MAO inhibitors, sympathomimetics
monitoring: Clinical response, neuropsychiatric symptoms, blood pressure
sideEffects: Dyskinesia (may increase), insomnia, nausea, dizziness, hallucinations
clinicalPearls: Used as adjunct to levodopa in Parkinson's disease to reduce OFF time; specialist-initiated in many regions.
indication: Adjunctive treatment in Parkinson's disease with motor fluctuations
